# Protocol selection routes through the matching manual settings step

The selected route maps imap/pop3 to manualConfigSubview and microsoft to exchangeSettingsSubview, then sets Back to protocolSelectSubview and transfers copied config. It throws for unsupported tokens. Added tests directly check Microsoft settings, Back selection and POP3 captured state, with Exchange type hidden until settings are complete. The token microsoft is this UI routing choice, not an EWS wire-name change. Accepted code later adds optional hostname clearing and more tests; no account, auth or UI execution was performed here.

Scope: Account Hub manual protocol state routing.
